title: Streaming tutor chat: SSE parsing, cancellation and an answer-leak guard
scenario: Kestrel's Angular tutor panel streams the agent's answer over SSE. Pilot bugs: lost words and broken characters, two answers mixed when a learner asks again, a spinner that never stops when the agent is down, and a reply that spelled out the answer to the learner's open quiz question. The logic is framework-free TypeScript + RxJS tested with jest.
task: parseSse that survives chunks cut anywhere, including inside UTF-8 characters
A streaming leak guard that redacts quiz answers split across tokens
A store with latest-wins cancellation, error states and a first-token timeout
acceptance: Hidden jest tests cut the stream at every byte offset
Guard: across tokens, no false positives, no early prefix
Store: cancellation, flush on done, citations, errors, timeout
